review.notes: Fixing review of the round-2 package (issue #9222) by Claude (Opus 5.5), session claude-Cs69KU. The fourteen supplier rows of the first review are resolved. PadicFamilies §4.0.1-4.0.3 was read at TauCetiRoadmap PR #1019 head f9ad8cc and supplies everything the package removed; that head cites nothing from this roadmap. A Sonnet cross-check of all 155 cited supplier sections against the live upstream heads and the atlas PadicHodgeRegulators/MotivicEtaleKTheory packages found every section present; its five partial matches were confirmed and fixed. Over forty locators were checked on the page: Kato 2004 (Numdam, sha 3c6e14b1), Rubin's 1999 draft, Nakamura arXiv:2006.13647v2 and 1201.6475v2, Loeffler, Burungale-Tian v2 and Weibel K-book III. Corrections: Kato's two-index zeta elements need M,N>=2 (Kato 2.1, p.125); the Fourier normalization of F^(k) is N^(-k), not N^(k-2) (Kato 3.6, p.138), now with a Check; the smoothed-F locator is p.143; the transfer of 1.2 is made explicit. A false Check in 6.1 (the factor 1-p^(-1)phi^(-1)) and an overstated Check in 6.6 (nonvanishing of the global class) are corrected. Supplier citations fixed: AutomorphicGaloisRepresentations §1.5 for the Fricke pairing; EulerSystemsAndKolyvaginSystems §2.1, not §2.6, and §2.5 with Shapiro, not §8.14, for the Delta-components; ModularForms Layer 9 for twisted L-values. 4.2a compares H^2(T)_0 with X_inf up to finite modules. 7.4 and 7.6 now assume p odd, because the Coleman map (PadicHodgeRegulators §§8.22, 9.36) and Greenberg's criterion (SelmerIwasawaCohomology §3.20) are odd-p. 7.7's control step is reworded, and Downstream consumers no longer lists two suppliers. The Lean was generalized to coefficient fields. lean-check: exit 0, only 8 sorry warnings, 292 lines. intake check-files: 0 problems. No duplication found on current TauCetiRoadmap main or in the Tau Ceti library at a91d3aaf. Maintainer notes are in the report.
